name: Folio restrained screenprint
description: A bold, limited-ink direction with controlled registration and no distressed poster effects.
promptTemplate:
Create one portfolio project icon.

Subject brief:
{{subject}}

Color palette:
Use only this selected palette target: {{colorPalette}}, with no more than four colors visible in the icon. Use the first color as the solid background.

Style contract:
Restrained screenprint icon, not a poster or scene. Use one dominant bold silhouette and at most two supporting forms, constructed from large flat spot-color shapes. Crisp deliberate registration is preferred; one very sparse regular dot screen may appear inside one subordinate form only. No distressed texture, paper grain, noise, gradients, lighting, cast shadows, gloss, bevels, photorealism, pseudo-text, labels, letters, logos, or colors outside the selected palette. The solid background is intended as a circular field. Keep every critical part within the central 70 percent of the canvas, circle-safe with a 15 percent margin. It must remain legible at 80, 96, and 112 pixels.
